Uncap

Private, on-device dictation for your Mac.
macOS 26 or later · Apple silicon

Download for Mac Buy — $39.99

Free for your first 50 dictations. One purchase, every Mac you own.

What it does

Hold a key, talk, let go. Uncap turns what you said into clean text and types it into whatever app you were in. Everything happens on your Mac: no account, no server, nothing leaves the machine.

Push to talk

Hold the key you choose, speak, release. The text lands where your cursor is.

On-device, start to finish

Recognition and cleanup run on Apple silicon. Your voice never goes to a server.

Speaking styles

Choose how tidy the cleanup is, from word-for-word to polished prose.

Your words

Teach it names and terms it should always get right.

Fix a word

Every dictation is kept so you can correct one word and paste it again.

One purchase

$39.99 once. No subscription. Updates are free.
